connector.name: Parser
connector.registryDescription: Parse receipts & invoices into structured JSON. Pay per call in USDC (x402 on Base), no API key.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package parsedoc-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.wrapper-agency.parsedoc, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: EVM wallet private key holding USDC on Base. When set, calls the paid endpoint at $0.02/page. If unset, uses the free demo (3/day).

env.name: PARSEDOC_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://parsedoc.wrapper-agency.com.
